layers.note: CRISM hydrated-mineral signals (HYD)2012 prototype browse mosaic, about 19 m source pixels. Colours show qualitative spectral signals, not mineral percentages or individual ridges. layers.note: THEMIS relative night IR brightnessAbout 163 m source pixels: only about 18 span this 3 km area. This multi-observation mosaic is relative night infrared brightness, not calibrated temperature, thermal inertia, current weather or reliable material classification. Fine relief visible under the translucent image comes from the terrain basemap, not THEMIS.Image credit: NASA/JPL-Caltech/Arizona State University; tiles from NASA Mars Trek.Open original source: NASA Mars Trek source
